questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 12 cm and a height of 10 cm. What is its area?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: Area is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 12 × 10 = 60 cm²; forgetting to halve gives the wrong 120 cm².

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 14 cm and a height of 8 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 14 × 8 = 56 cm²; the halving step is what rushing skips.

questions.subject: Commerce
questions.prompt: In a business plan, which section outlines day-to-day running of the business?
questions.why: The operations plan describes how the business actually runs day-to-day, while the executive summary, market analysis and financial plan cover overview, competition and money instead.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: In Freud's model, which part is mostly conscious and rational?

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In an open container, why might measured mass seem to change after a reaction?
questions.why: In an open system, gases can escape into or enter from the air, so the measured mass changes even though total mass is still conserved overall.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What sign of a chemical reaction would you see if it releases heat?
questions.why: A rise in temperature shows energy is being released, a common sign that a chemical reaction is taking place.
